summary.key_theme: Apple 在新任執行長 John Ternus 的帶領下推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，市場對其硬體創新與長期成長潛力持正面看法，儘管面臨中國市場價格競爭壓力。

bullish.title: Apple makes biggest change to iPhone release cadence in 7 years in Ternus' first showcase as CEO
bullish.reason: 新任執行長 John Ternus 首次亮相並推出首款摺疊手機，標誌著 Apple 產品發布節奏的重大轉變，被視為推動未來成長的關鍵催化劑。

bullish.title: Apple Bought Back More Than $880 Billion of Its Own Stock During Tim Cook's 15 Years as CEO
bullish.reason: 回顧過去 15 年高達 8,800 億美元的庫藏股回購，凸顯 Apple 強大的現金流與對股東價值的長期承諾。

bullish.title: Apple, Taiwan Semi Lead Five Stocks Near Buy Points
bullish.reason: 技術分析顯示 Apple 股價接近買入點，配合新產品發布的市場預期，吸引投資人關注。

bullish.title: Can New iPhone Duo Power Apple's Stock Higher?
bullish.reason: 分析師認為 iPhone Duo 的創新設計有望成為 Apple 股價上漲的強勁驅動力。

bullish.title: Warren Buffett Made Apple Berkshire Hathaway's Single Largest Stock Position
bullish.reason: 回顧巴菲特長期持有 Apple 的績效，強化了市場對該公司長期投資價值的信心。

bearish.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
bearish.reason: iPhone Duo 在中國市場面臨小米與華為等低價摺疊手機的激烈競爭，價格策略將成為市場考驗。

bearish.title: Jim Cramer Flips the Script: Why Older Investors Should Ditch Growth Stocks for 30-Year Treasuries
bearish.reason: Jim Cramer 建議退休投資人減少對成長股（如 Apple）的配置，轉向債券，可能對短期散戶情緒造成壓力。

bearish.title: Sonera Acquisition Bodes Well for Apple Stock in the Long Term, But Negative Catalysts Appear to Be Weighing on the Firm’s Performance
bearish.reason: 儘管收購 Sonera 有利長期發展，但市場仍擔憂短期內存在的負面催化劑影響股價表現。

neutral.title: Apple wants AI to listen all day without creeping people out
neutral.reason: 探討 Apple 在 AI 穿戴裝置上的隱私解決方案，屬於技術研發層面的討論，對股價影響中性。

neutral.title: SpaceX vs. Apple: Wall Street Sees Strong Upside for One of These Stocks and Remains Neutral On the Other
neutral.reason: 華爾街對 Apple 的目標價看法趨於中性，顯示市場在產品發布後進入觀望期。
